status: Three declared local iterations on an adaptively inspected archive; all results are retrospective, not independent evidence
round_1: Keep the old shared affine log residual and additive prior. Replace softmin expected regret by measured signed pair-gap squared error and observed-best squared margin loss. Equal anchor/pair/margin coefficients; ridge 0.001.
round_2: Use a joint positive direct-time execution potential with 6 host and 13 fused coordinates. The host includes MK and an MK log tail, plus K/N depth interactions; fused includes K/q, q serial work, grid pressure, and grouped-N couplings. Existing traffic basis selection is refit inside each training fold. This changes both the basis and output units and must not be attributed to a single feature.
round_3: Select loss composition only inside training: pair=1, margin in [0,1,4], ridge in [0.0001,0.001,0.01], anchor=1. Choose mean actual regret, then maximum regret, then relative time error. Each inner fit refits the traffic basis and scaler; no outer-label access.
bound: Sum of squared best-relative margin violations bounds squared regret of the argmin over the measured eligible candidates for direct-time training; log round bounds squared log1p(regret). This does not bound unseen-workload regret.
numerics: Convex differentiable objective, constrained L-BFGS-B for direct time, analytic gradients; require solver success and projected gradient <=1e-5. Maximum 1500 iterations, 4000 evaluations and 30 seconds per full fit; cache bounded.
gates: Keep all prior primary/leave-K, 328 deletion choices, old adversarial witness and 34 one-percent stress checks unchanged. Report every variant, no boundary-specific host margin or hand-coded M512 exception.
stop: Complete the three declared rounds and diagnose errors. No automatic compiler promotion or GPU package modification.
